visualCharacteristics.purpose: Side-by-side product comparison cards with a title header band, labelled detail sections with check-mark lists, and CTAs pinned to the bottom

contentPattern.structure: one row per card: title heading (optionally with an icon image beside it), then description, label + check-list sections separated by horizontal rules or separate cells, and closing link-only paragraphs that become the bottom CTAs

reuseGuidance: Use for 3-4 product or plan comparisons. with-icon-header when the header band carries an icon; coloured-top-bar for tier cards with a coloured bar over the title; shadow/shadow-blue for elevated cards.
